custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with the new number.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Work Orders in the top bar.
  6. Open work order 1 from the Work Orders list (Work Orders in the top bar).
  7. Click New Line.
  8. Type canned job A's name in Title.
  9. Pick canned job A in the list.
  10. Click Save & Close.
